facts.fact: ANIES reports that under the Nafa project it opened electronic wallet accounts for women household heads, issued phones and SIM cards, and pays them monthly through five contracted payment operators, and plans to keep this mobile-money payment arrangement for the Food Shock Window transfers.
facts.system: ANIES beneficiary database and wallet transfers (Projet Nafa)

facts.fact: ANIES says its information-systems experts manage the database of beneficiaries of the programmes it has run since 2020, from which households were enrolled and listed for the Nafa cash transfers.
